weeks.title: REPORTING AND ADMISSION
outcomes: REPORTING AND ADMISSION
weeks.safety: Ergonomic guidelines, electrical safety protocols.

weeks.title: Introduction to Digital Literacy & Hardware Components
outcomes:
By the end of the lesson the learner should be able to:
Define digital literacy and state 3 workplace benefits within 15 min.
 Differentiate 5 ICT tools and their uses in group activity.
Explain how digital literacy supports employability in 5 min presentation.

Identify 5 internal and 5 external components in 15 min.
 Explain functions of CPU, RAM, and storage.
 Classify 12 devices as input/output/storage in 10 min.
weeks.safety: Ergonomic guidelines, electrical safety protocols.

weeks.title: Input & Output Devices & Basic Computer Operation
outcomes:
Identify 5 input and 5 output devices in 15 min.
Explain one real-world use of each.
 Connect and use an external device in 10 min.

Demonstrate startup and shutdown twice in 10 min.
Apply 5 keyboard shortcuts.
Customize wallpaper/screensaver in 15 min.
weeks.safety: Ergonomic guidelines, electrical safety protocols.

weeks.title: Introduction to Word Processing
outcomes:
Create and save a new document in 10 min.
Open, close, rename 2 docs in 15 min.
 Switch between 2 docs in 5 min.
weeks.safety: Ergonomic guidelines, electrical safety protocols.

weeks.title: Continuous Assessment Test 1 (CT1)
outcomes: Evaluate mastery of digital literacy fundamentals, computer architecture, and word processing.
weeks.safety: Strict assessment integrity and lab protocol.

weeks.title: Spreadsheets Fundamentals & Data Entry
outcomes: Enter and format spreadsheet data, utilize basic arithmetic formulas and cell references.
weeks.safety: Ergonomic workstation posture and eye relief.

weeks.title: Database Concepts & Table Manipulation
outcomes: Create and structure relational tables, populate fields, and construct basic search queries.
weeks.safety: Data backup and safe file management.

weeks.title: Presentation Slides & Multimedia Objects
outcomes: Design slide layouts, format text boxes, and embed relevant diagrams and multimedia.
weeks.safety: Audio/visual comfort and safety standards.

weeks.title: Internet Connectivity, Network Security & Emerging Technologies
outcomes: Identify network topologies, browser protocols, cyber hygiene principles, and safe browsing habits.
weeks.safety: Digital privacy, credential protection, and cyber safety.

weeks.title: Internal Summative Assessment & Portfolio Verification
outcomes: Demonstrate practical competence in end-of-term digital literacy portfolio requirements.
weeks.safety: Comprehensive workstation inspection and emergency exit readiness.

weeks.title: REPORTING AND ADMISSION WEEK
outcomes: Orientation to computing lab protocols, curriculum structure, and learning outcomes.
weeks.safety: Ergonomic guidelines, electrical safety protocols.

weeks.title: Computer Hardware Architecture & Internal Peripherals
outcomes: Identify and classify motherboard architecture, microprocessor units, volatile and non-volatile storage.
weeks.safety: Electrostatic discharge prevention, component handling care.

weeks.title: Operating System Installation & Driver Configuration
outcomes: Prepare bootable installation media, configure firmware settings, and perform clean OS installation.
weeks.safety: Mains voltage precautions and electrical isolation.

weeks.title: System Utilities & Diagnostic Software Execution
outcomes: Execute system health utilities, partition management, and disk defragmentation.
weeks.safety: Data loss prevention and backup validation.

weeks.title: Continuous Assessment Test 1 (CT1 Theory & Practical)
outcomes: Assess hardware diagnostics, safe assembly protocols, and driver installations.
weeks.safety: Exam protocol and laboratory order.

weeks.title: Peripheral Device Interfacing & Port Configurations
outcomes: Connect and configure printers, scanners, display adapters, and external storage interfaces.
weeks.safety: Cable management and trip hazard mitigation.

weeks.title: Local Area Network Cabling & IP Addressing
outcomes: Terminate CAT6 UTP cables with RJ45 connectors and verify end-to-end continuity.
weeks.safety: Tool safety, wire-cutting precision.

weeks.title: Preventive Maintenance & Hardware Cleaning Procedures
outcomes: Apply contact cleaner, compressed air blowers, and inspect thermal paste application.
weeks.safety: Adequate lab ventilation, chemical handling caution.

weeks.title: Computer Lab Safety & Electrical Protection Devices
outcomes: Analyze uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), surge arrestors, and grounding circuits.
weeks.safety: High voltage isolation and grounding verification.

weeks.title: Summative Assessment & Portfolio Compilation
outcomes: Complete final practical competency assessments and compile portfolio of evidence.
weeks.safety: Full laboratory restoration and power shutdown procedure.
